Technology Commons will use this section for research, classroom experiments, technical notes, and reflections on technology education.
:::

The previous Backgammon research articles have been removed from this migration branch. The reusable Research presentation layer remains in place so new Technology Commons work can be added without rebuilding the visual system.

Future topics may include engineering design, project-based learning, computing, fabrication, transportation technology, assessment, open educational resources, and the NICE design process.
